abstract: On the Fermat quartic K3 surface and the Fermat quintic threefold, we construct K\"ahler metrics from explicit rational polynomial potentials and bound their differences from the Ricci-flat metrics in integral tensor norms. For specified compact families of smooth quartic and quintic hypersurfaces near the Fermat hypersurfaces, we give a terminating algorithm that constructs polynomial K\"ahler metrics with prescribed pointwise bounds on their differences from the Ricci-flat metrics and on their Ricci forms. The resulting metrics converge to the Ricci-flat metrics in every $C^r$ norm, uniformly in the parameter.
hook: Explicit polynomial metrics approximate the Ricci-flat metrics on a quartic K3 surface and quintic threefold.
hook_turn: approximate the Ricci-flat metrics on a quartic K3 surface and quintic threefold.
summary: On the Fermat quartic K3 surface and Fermat quintic threefold, the authors construct Kahler metrics from explicit rational polynomial potentials and bound their distance from the true Ricci-flat metrics. A terminating algorithm extends this to nearby smooth hypersurfaces, with convergence in every C^r norm. It applies to specified compact families near Fermat, not to all quartics or quintics.
title: Polynomial approximations to Calabi--Yau metrics on quartic K3 surfaces and quintic threefolds
